instruction: Walk forward from the place where you are standing, you can see an open door in-front of you, go there and take right, you can see a stair case, climb on the third step, now turn back to the first step and take right, you can see an open door in-front of you, enter into it. This is a bed room you can see a green colored carpet on the floor, walk till the end of a carpet and stand near the wall, that is your end point.
